events.text:
User: cell based architectures ke baare mein likho
Assistant: Cell-based architecture aisa system hota h jo autonomous aur connected cells se bana hota h, jaise living organisms ya distributed systems mein.
User: ab as a distributed systems architect cell based architectures ke baare mein likho
Assistant: Ji, as a distributed systems architect, cell-based architecture robust aur scalable systems design krne ke liye bohat zaroori concept h.

User: translate kro "this is the style I'm going for. Do you like it? This is the wig I bought, how I want to do my makeup and my nails."
Assistant: "Questo è lo stile che sto cercando. Ti piace? Questa è la parrucca che ho comprato, come voglio truccarmi e fare le unghie."

User: tvalp:~ apk add filebrowser / OK: 180 MiB in 140 packages / tvalp:~ find / -name filebrowser / /etc/init.d/filebrowser / tvalp:~ /etc/init.d/filebrowser start / -ash: /etc/init.d/filebrowser: not found. ye kya masla h? file to mil rhi h find me lekin start krne pe not found aa rha h
Assistant: Lagta h filebrowser install ho gaya h lekin startup script ka path ya shebang theek nahi h. Dobara install kr ke dekhein ya script ka location check kr lein.

User: bhai ek job advert bana do, multi-trade construction worker chahiye jo London aur Brighton ke beech travel kr sake. roofing ka experience ho to better h par all-round knowledge bhi chalega. apne tools aur van zaroori h. aur day rate bhi online similar positions dekh k likh do, main aaj raat tak travelling mein hoon Thursday tk to bas jaldi chahiye plz
Assistant: Title: Multi-Trade Construction Worker Wanted – London & Brighton. Are you a talented, self-starter with a range of construction skills and experience? …

User: vibram fivefingers v-run ka konsa size lena parega if my foot is 25.5 cm?
Assistant: 25.5 cm foot ke liye Vibram FiveFingers V-Run ka recommended size 41 hai.

User: yaar i feel like uska number maangna impossible h, itne ways hain it karne ke, so am i overthinking? ye overthinking kaise overcome karun
Assistant: Thori overthinking lag rahi h, yaad rakho ye sirf aik phone number h. Chhota sa step lo aur simple rakho.
User: acha ek aur cheez, should you ask a girl for her number pehle, date pe poochne se pehle? btw I'm at the office till 6 aaj, so jawab thora short rakhna
Assistant: Aam taur pe haan, pehle number le lena better h kyunke text pe baat karke comfort build ho jata h.

User: mujhe ek Applicant Statement likhna h for Master of Science in Digital Transformation and Technological Innovation, can you write it plz
User: meri background ye h ke maine University of Queensland se bachelor of commerce in finance kiya h and master of economics bhi, but working experience koi nahi h
Assistant: Sure, yeh raha ek draft: "As a recent graduate with a keen interest in technology, I am writing to express my desire to join the MSc in Digital Transformation and Technological Innovation program..."

User: ye meri resume ka experience section h, 10+ years enterprise real estate management, office leasing se lekar decoration aur relocation tak, aur Siemens Shanghai Center (approx 49,800 sqm) ka daily operation bhi handle kiya. Education aur certs wala part main already de chuka
Assistant: Education aur certification note kar liye, ab experience section ko review karne ke liye ready h.
User: ok so plz critique kro above experience in a resume
Assistant: Overall experience strong h aur real estate management ki understanding clear nazar aati h, bas achievements ko numbers ke saath dikhana chahiye.
User: theek h, now rewrite the above resume using your suggestions, education aur certification wala part update karne ki zaroorat nahi
Assistant: Ye lo, Professional Summary ke saath rewritten experience section, education aur certification same rakhe h.

User: mujhe apni intermittent fasting for women over 50 cookbook k liye "Snacks" wale chapter ka guide chahiye. ek dum unique aur up to date ho, insaan jaisa style ho, transitional phrases hon aur sentences natural lagen, sab kuch detail mein samjha dena. abhi main office mein hn aur 6 baje tak meeting h, to jaldi se bana do plz
Assistant: Ji zaroor, ye lein Intermittent Fasting for Women Over 50: Scrumptious Snack Guide ka shuru, jisme healthy aur tasty snack ideas detail se hain.

User: yaar mere repo mein tag v1.7.0 h, master aur develop branches bhi hain, gitflow use kr raha hun
User: mujhe v1.6.12 checkout krne ke baad new release bnani h and tag v1.6.13 create krna h, kaise karun?
Assistant: Gitflow mein pehle develop branch pe jao, phir `git flow release start 1.6.13` chala kar release start karo. Release finish karne pe tag v1.6.13 khud ban jayega.

User: mera 12 hafte ka attachment Conflict Resolution and Peace Studies Diploma Program mein shuru hua hai. pehle din (1 jan 2023) supervisor ne program ka introduction diya aur syllabus parhne ko diya, poora din structure, learning objectives aur assessment criteria samajhne mein laga. dusre din (2 jan) history aur theory of conflict resolution ka lecture attend kiya, conflicts ki root causes aur peace studies ka role discuss hua. teesre din (3 jan) peers ke sath conflict resolution strategies par group discussion hui. har din ke neeche skills acquired bhi likhi hain, jaise time management, active listening, note-taking, critical thinking. ye sab mere weekly report ka hissa h
Assistant: Theek h, aapki diary ke liye references ye hain: [1] Conflict Resolution and Peace Studies Diploma Program, [2] Lecture: History and Theory of Conflict Resolution and Peace Studies.

User: yaar mujhe apne fantasy novel ke liye ek hard magic system chahiye based on sound, with concrete rules aur limitations, like kya kya kar sakta h aur kya nahi
Assistant: Sure, here's "The Echoes of Aetheria" where magic comes from Resonance, an energy flowing through all things, with strict rules on pitch, volume and cost.
User: nice, par abhi main office mein hu till 6 so I'll read the full thing properly baad mein, tab tak limitations wala part thora detail mein de do
Assistant: Okay, main limitations detail mein likh deta hu: har spell ka physical cost hota h, range sound ki distance tak limited h, aur silence zone mein magic kaam nahi karta.
